description: Source code for Zend Framework's HTTP Client class, implementing an HTTP client with support for various request methods, headers, cookies, authentication, redirects, and file uploads.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client
classes.description: Implements an HTTP client supporting various request methods, headers, cookies, authentication, redirects, and file uploads.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the request URI, accepting string or Zend_Uri_Http object.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the request URI as string or object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the HTTP client.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the HTTP request method.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets request headers, accepting string, array, or full header string.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header.

methods.name: setParameterGet
methods.description: Sets GET parameters.

methods.name: setParameterPost
methods.description: Sets POST parameters.

methods.name: _setParameter
methods.description: Helper to set GET or POST parameters.

methods.name: getRedirectionsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of redirects on the last request.

methods.name: setAuth
methods.description: Configures HTTP authentication.

methods.name: setCookieJar
methods.description: Sets the cookie jar object.

methods.name: getCookieJar
methods.description: Returns the current cookie jar.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the request, either via cookie jar or headers.

methods.name: setFileUpload
methods.description: Sets a file for upload in a POST request.

methods.name: setEncType
methods.description: Sets the encoding type for POST data.

methods.name: setRawData
methods.description: Sets raw POST data.

methods.name: resetParameters
methods.description: Resets all GET and POST parameters and related headers.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP request as string.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP response object.

methods.name: setAdapter
methods.description: Loads and sets the connection adapter.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends the HTTP request and returns the response, handling redirects.

methods.name: prepare_headers
methods.description: Prepares request headers for sending.

methods.name: prepare_body
methods.description: Prepares request body for POST/PUT requests.

methods.name: _getParametersRecursive
methods.description: Flattens nested parameters array into key-value pairs.

methods.name: encodeFormData
methods.description: Encodes form data for multipart/form-data POST requests.

methods.name: encodeAuthHeader
methods.description: Creates an Authorization header for HTTP authentication.
